issues.detail: The Vietnamese translation adds a specific temporal context ('Còn ít lâu các ngươi sẽ chẳng thấy Ta' - 'Soon you will not see me') that is not present in the Greek. The Greek text says 'mikron' (little/small) twice, referring to the *amount of time* or *extent* of the interval, but it does not specify the content of what they wouldn't see. The Vietnamese version treats the first 'mikron' as a negative statement about seeing Him, whereas the Greek is a parallel structure: 'ask each other... for a little [time] I said, and for a little [time] you will see me'.
